title: P1-C polarization normalization and global mode-resolved transport diagnostic

equation_normalization.mode_production_rate: Gamma_prod,h = m_V^2/(24 pi omega) integral_{-1}^{1} dz W_h(z) f_nu(E1) f_antinu(E2), per g^2
equation_normalization.sum_identity: W_L+W_++W_-=3/2; each W_h integrates to 1 over z in [-1,1]
equation_normalization.scalar_sum: sum_h Gamma_prod,h = m_V^2/(8 pi omega) times the unweighted pair average; agrees with scalar B.7 normalization
equation_normalization.B2_literal_mapping: The B.6--B.10 equation chain carries the polarization sum through production, absorption, and detailed balance. The scalar Gamma_abs entering the literal B.2 chain is the polarization-summed rate, not the per-mode average.
equation_normalization.physical_transport: Mode-resolved escaped luminosity is proportional to sum_h source_h <exp(-tau_h)>; it is not equal to exp(-sum_h tau_h), nor generally exp(-sum_h tau_h/3).

calculation.engine: Direct V8 binary64 calculation, not GitHub Actions
calculation.propagation: fixed omega, Euclidean chord to 25 km
calculation.compton_mode_decomposition: B.14 no-recoil Thomson-limit inverse cross sections: w_L=(m_V^2/omega^2)/(2+m_V^2/omega^2), w_+=w_-=1/(2+m_V^2/omega^2); same weights for source and opacity

conclusions: The literal scalar B.2 implementation is consistent with the polarization-summed B.6--B.10 production/absorption/detailed-balance chain; no extra factor of three is to be inserted or removed.
The B.14 no-recoil Compton mode weights are almost entirely transverse in the 210--510 MeV band.
The B.14-weighted mode-resolved result is 38.9 times the literal scalar result, increasing escape and moving in the wrong direction for explaining the current over-bright strong-endpoint result.
The older equal-third Compton split changes the mode-resolved luminosity by about 5.1%, but does not change the qualitative conclusion.
The scalar baseline remains unchanged; mode-resolved transport is a distinct physical extension.
limitations: This global mode-resolved result is restricted to the 210--510 MeV band, not a complete re-integration of all Fig. 7 energies.
The B.14 Compton mode weights use the no-recoil Thomson-limit inverse-cross-section ratios, not a full recoil-resolved kernel.
The mode-resolved result is a diagnostic transport model, not evidence that the unpublished Fig. 7 code used mode-resolved propagation.
